frame.stratum: scanDate x pool x nearestChannel x exact A/B checkPattern
frame.missingCellRule: Absent cell is zero only on a CLEAN complete parent frame; otherwise UNKNOWN.
frame.duplicateRule: Duplicate parent keys block CLEAN quality; never silently deduplicate.
frame.invalidStratumRule: Missing nearest channel or incomplete bitmask blocks CLEAN quality.

redundancyGuard.note: Exact six-bit masks are preserved for provenance even though some bits are structurally dependent.
redundancyGuard.bStrongCloseUpperShadow: Do not interpret Hamming count as independent-dimensional distance; strongClose pass implies upperShadow pass under coherent OHLC.

nonClaims: No claim that sampled rows are the semantic population.
